async def run(items, save, width):
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 4, save, 1)
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 1, save, 4)
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 1, save, "4")
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 1, save, 4.5)
    # ok: serial-bounded-helper-python
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, 1, retries=5)
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 1, save, width=4)
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 1, save, width=width)
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 4, save, width=1)
    # ok: serial-bounded-helper-python
    await pool.map_with_concurrency(1, items, save, retries=5)
    local = 1
    # ok: serial-bounded-helper-python
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, local)
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, min(1, width))
    await map_with_concurrency(items, save, min(4, width))
